title: Adapted Cocycles and Tensor Subsystems of Free Filtrations
exact_target: Define adapted cocycles for the free filtration, construct them from tensor units, and determine whether the largest tensor subsystem generates the free system.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001178 (OWR-3392-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Product Systems and Independence in Quantum Dynamics (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/09, pp. 493--548; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 38, printed page 530.
Skeide free product systems and adapted cocycles; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: There are three retained requests: the adaptedness notion, the proposed Fock-case construction from units, and generation by the intersection tensor subsystem. The last request is repeated separately at ID 30001179.
